name: hammered
notes: Peened metal as a dual-gated triple: flat-toned polygonal dents (per-cell value dominant, dome shading a hint), bright facet rims via negative wall depth. Coverage is the damage dial per the review principle: damage is a delta from baseline, contrast/coverage is how much of it there is. Levels 30/55/80 = light/medium/heavy, calibrated to core-band stroke coverage by tools/fractal-tip.mjs --calibrate; verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. REVISED to a tonal mask (maskMode tonal): the tip carries the tone-mapped field itself rather than a threshold cut, value-curve deconvolved by the mask train's overlap (v = 1-(depth*damage)^(1/n)); the level number is now the damage/modulation DEPTH, not coverage - moderate damage renders as moderate contrast over intact paint. SPLOTCH fix on review (dark/light discs at stroke width): the mask train is now near-rigid - dual scatter 0.7->0.2, so the per-point stamp count n is deterministic and the composite tone v^n stops wandering at stamp scale; the field is high-passed above 1.4 c/dia (spec highpassK) so no stamp tints its whole footprint; tonal masks skip the 1/H spectral pre-comp (a near-rigid train transfers the tip spectrum directly).
